payloadClassification.description: One captured payload's classification against the declared payload contract (ht-xoc.1 classify): ok, violation (a well-formed payload that breaks the contract: event and field name where) or malformed (never a violation).

probeContract.description: Optional, not a check: the payload-contract verdicts of the probe's canary_payloads runs. release is reserved (null) for the latest release's verdicts, which scripts/canary/release_contract.sh collects separately.

probeResult.description: --probe stdout: one probe's outcome. failed_tier is 1 when a tier-1 check failed (bisect retries twice), 0 for a tier-0 failure (retried once), null when nothing failed.

canaryProbe.description: /canary-probe.json, written by harness-canary.sh from versions.py data (harness-versions.json or --versions-json; never --baseline). expected_admission is the explicit historical ladder/schema diagnostic expectation for capture qualification; ordinary live/saved doctor core admission is checked separately and proves no exact runtime or native capability.

x-files.help: /help/.txt — raw `codex --help` and `codex exec --help` output, written by harness-canary.sh, read by launch_tables; file names: codex.txt, codex-exec.txt
